Laravel Composer library `pepperfm/api-responder-for-laravel`, branch `3.x`; standardized API JSON responses via DI/Facade. Not a Laravel application; classes live in `Pepperfm\ApiBaseResponder` under `src/`.

Commands:
vendor/bin/pest --filter="test name"
vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/ApiBaseResponderTest.php
composer lint-hard

Every PHP file requires `declare(strict_types=1)` (Pint-enforced). Laravel Pint preset/custom rules: `pint.json`. Classes/functions: opening braces next line; control structures: same line. Closures: `fn()` (no space). Imports: no ordering (not alphabetical). `not_operator_with_successor_space`: false (`!$var`). `phpdoc_to_property_type` and `phpdoc_to_return_type` enabled; prefer native types.

Direct API: `ApiBaseResponder::response()`, `stored()`, `deleted()` use config-based key resolution via private `buildJsonResponse()`. No `debug_backtrace()`.

Builder API: `build()` blank builder; `forMethod('show')` adds REST context; `withDataKey('users')` sets explicit key; `fromAction()` reads calling-method PHP attributes using opt-in minimal backtrace. Key priority: explicit `withDataKey()` > attributes (`#[ResponseDataKey]`) via `fromAction()` > REST convention (`show`/`update` singular, others plural) via `forMethod()` > `laravel-api-responder.plural_data_key` config. `paginated()` delegates to `MetaResolver::resolve()` for `LengthAwarePaginator`/
